blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Police arrested a person listed as the municipality’s Top 2 Most Wanted Person in connection with a homicide case on Monday, Nov. 9. In a press release on Tuesday (Nov. 10), Sta. Maria Municipal Police Station (MPS) said its tracker team, led by Officer in Charge Police Captain June C. Molina, together with personnel from the Ilocos Sur Provincial Intelligence Unit (ISPIU), carried out the arrest by virtue of a warrant issued by the Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 22 in Narvacan, Ilocos Sur.
